topics.title: Circles and the compass in artwork

concepts.learning_objective: Describe a circle as all points at the same distance (radius) from its centre.
Use a compass with a fixed radius to draw circles and half circles in artwork such as the wavy wave.

topics.title: Squares and rectangles: properties and names

concepts.learning_objective: State the two defining properties of a rectangle and of a square.
Name a rectangle or square by listing its corners in an order of travel around it.
Explain why a rotated square or rectangle keeps its properties, including on a dot grid.
Construct a square of given side using a ruler, perpendiculars and a compass.
Construct a rectangle of given sides and check that it satisfies the rectangle properties.
Investigate how the distance between points moving on opposite sides of a rectangle changes.
Plan with a rough diagram and construct rectangles that divide into identical squares.
Use side lengths to place a square inside a rectangle with the same centre.
Compare the diagonals of a rectangle and the angles into which a diagonal divides its corners.
Construct a rectangle when a diagonal divides its opposite angles into given parts.
Construct a rectangle from one side and a diagonal using an arc to locate a corner.

topics.title: Points equidistant from two given points

concepts.learning_objective: Locate a point at given distances from two points by drawing intersecting arcs.
Plan the order of steps in a construction such as the House figure.
Construct a 4-sided figure with all sides equal that is not a square.
